arguments.name: array
arguments.type: previously dimensioned one- or two-dimensional floating-point field

semantics.summary: Outputs a vector on one row with comma-separated elements, or a matrix with a rowfeed after each row. Output may be redirected to a channel; optional g and n formatting follows STR$(x,g,n).
side-effects: Writes formatted numeric output to the selected screen or output channel.

notes: The optional channel and formatting arguments are documented in the addendum.

The printed page images were visually checked; this declaration is still marked book-documented because its behavior has not been independently cross-checked against a second primary witness or observed runtime.
